title: Puppet Master internal-interchange, target-adapter, and PM-native plugin package contracts
description: Closed pre-build manifests, target-adapter outputs, package/conformance records, and lifecycle receipts. Compatibility names beginning portable_ and PortableConformanceReport denote the Puppet Master internal interchange only; they do not claim direct OpenAI/Codex or Claude Code loadability. Central plugin command registration and production-intent wiring are separate admitted facts; this schema creates no native plugin handler, executable runtime, or Event Authority.

PortablePluginManifest.description: Compatibility type name for PM's internal plugin.json plus mcp.json interchange. It is not directly loadable external-agent package metadata.

PortableConformanceReport.description: Compatibility report name for PM internal-interchange validation only; target ecosystem conformance is a separate TargetAdapterConformanceReport.
